title: MZ I purchased RPG Maker Action Combat - RPG Maker MZ Plugin and I'm getting an error.

posts.author: Vladar458
posts.body:
I purchased RPG Maker Action Combat - RPG Maker MZ Plugin from Sang Hendrix and I'm getting this error when I try to load the game.
And this is the console when I open it.

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body: Hello there! That one is a commercial plugin, so you should ask for support where you bought it.

posts.author: Vladar458
posts.body:
Canned_Dinosaur said:
Hello there! That one is a commercial plugin, so you should ask for support where you bought it.
Click to expand...
I did it, but I'm still waiting for an answer there, so I tought maybe someone here could help me.

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body: In that case, try opening the plugin file and look at row 2685. What does it say? Just to check: you haven’t possibly (accidentally) modified the plugin? Asking because this seems a somewhat unlikely error to slip in a plugin.

posts.author: Vladar458
posts.body:
Canned_Dinosaur said:
In that case, try opening the plugin file and look at row 2685. What does it say? Just to check: you haven’t possibly (accidentally) modified the plugin? Asking because this seems a somewhat unlikely error to slip in a plugin.
Click to expand...
Thank you, I already received an answer from the creator. Turns out the plugin doesn't work in older version of RPG Maker MZ, so I had to download the current version.
